Nora H.: Quick sync: drafting a tiny playbook for peering->relay switchover with zero app downtime. Thoughts?
Diego M.: Keep NAT mappings stable for existing TCP flows, pin for 2m after switch.
Anya B.: Add a route-stability signal (flap_count with 15s decay). If unstable prefer relay for new conns.
Nora H.: Operator beta flag: `switch_mode=mirror|dual|cutover`, with `revert_after_secs`. CLI sample: `POST /v1/tenants/900/switch {"mode":"mirror","revert_after_secs":300}`
Diego M.: Mirror needs dedupe in metrics/billing. Tag mirrored requests with `X-Switch-Run: <uuid>` so downstream can de-dup.
Anya B.: Prewarm relay group to 2x baseline for 10m before scheduled switch to avoid autoscale thrash.
ops-bot: relay-autoscaler: group-relay-a scaled 4->12 during last test replay
Nora H.: Rollback triggers: >=1% error increase over 5m, src_ip_preserved=false >0.2% sampled, autoscaler thrash.
Diego M.: I'll own the pinning impl and dedupe header.
Anya B.: I'll add the route stability metric and a post-cutover verification sweep for src_ip_preserved_pct.
Nora H.: I'll write the short RFC and schedule a 20m dry-run Thurs 10:30 PT. Any objections?
Diego M.: :thumbsup:
Anya B.: +1
